# Kerslide

> Kerslide is a free, calm block puzzle that runs in the browser. You place pieces on an 8×8 board; every time you clear a line the whole board shifts: right after a row clear, down after a column clear. Blocks pushed off the edge are gone. No download, no sign-up, no timers or lives.

Play: https://kerslide.com/play/ (about 4 MB to load, works on phone, tablet and desktop, installable as a web app). Progress is stored on the device.

## Modes
- Classic: play for a high score until no piece fits.
- Daily Challenge: the same starting position for every player each day, with a streak.
- Levels: gem puzzles on prepared boards (999 levels). Remove every gem by clearing its line or shifting it off the edge. Stars: 3 within par moves, 2 within twice par, 1 for any win.

## Facts
- Board: 8×8. Hand of 3 pieces; pieces do not rotate.
- Scoring: 1 point per placed block, 100 per cleared line, with multipliers for several lines at once and for consecutive clears (combo up to 400%).
- Languages (15): English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Turkish, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese.
- Accessibility: colorblind-friendly shapes, high contrast, reduced motion, larger text.
- Also on itch.io and Game Jolt. Developer: Kerslide.
